text: Adult: give epinephrine 0.3 to 0.5 mg IM in the mid-outer thigh. Can repeat every 5 to 15 minutes (or more frequently), as needed. If epinephrine is injected promptly IM, most patients respond to 1, 2, or at most, 3 doses. If symptoms are not responding to epinephrine injections, prepare IV epinephrine for infusion.

text: Patients ≥18 years if they have minimal pre-stroke disability, (modified Rankin Scale < 1), Have a causative occlusion of the internal carotid artery or proximal middle cerebral artery, Have a NIHSS score of ≥ 6, have a reassuring non-contrast head CT (ASPECT score of ≥ 6), And if they can be treated within 6 h of last known normal.
sents_en: Patients ≥18 years if they have minimal pre-stroke disability, (modified Rankin Scale < 1), Have a causative occlusion of the internal carotid artery or proximal middle cerebral artery, Have a NIHSS score of ≥ 6, have a reassuring non-contrast head CT (ASPECT score of ≥ 6), And if they can be treated within 6 h of last known normal.
sents_khm: អ្នកជំងឺដែលមានអាយុ ≥១៨ឆ្នាំ ប្រសិនបើពួកគេមានភាពខ្វះខាតមុនពេលដាច់សរសៃឈាមសរសៃឈាមខួរក្បាលតិចតួច (វិញ្ញាសា Rankin ដែលត្រូវបានកែប្រែ <១) មានការបិទជាមូលហេតុនៃសរសៃឈាមសរសៃឈាមខួរក្បាលខាងក្នុង ឬសរសៃឈាមខួរក្បាលមជ្ឈមណ្ឌលមជ្ឈមណ្ឌលមជ្ឈមណ្ឌល NIHSS មានកម្រិត ≥៦ មានកម្រិត CT ក្បាលដែលមិនមានភាពខុសគ្នា (កម្រិត ASPECT មានកម្រិត ≥៦) និងប្រសិនបើពួកគេអាចព្យាបាលបានក្នុងរយៈពេល ៦ម៉ោងនៃកម្រិតធម្មតាចុងក្រោយដែលគេស្គាល់។
sents_khm_back: Patients ≥ 18 years of age if they had a pre-mammogram deficiency (modified Rankin criterion <1) had a blockage due to internal hemorrhagic or cerebrospinal hemorrhage, NIHSS grade ≥ 6 had a CT scan of the head with no difference (ASPECT grade ≥ 6), and if they were curable within 6 hours of the last known normal dose.
